sections.section_title: The Son of Man's Authority to Forgive Sins on Earth
sections.summary: Jesus declares a paralytic's sins forgiven, provoking the scribes' charge of blasphemy, and heals the man to demonstrate that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.

sections.section_title: Calling the Excluded and Eating with Sinners
sections.summary: Jesus calls Levi the tax collector, dines with sinners and tax collectors, and defines his mission as calling sinners rather than the righteous.

sections.section_title: The Bridegroom, the New Cloth, and the New Wine
sections.summary: Jesus identifies himself as the bridegroom whose presence makes fasting inappropriate, hints at his violent removal, and declares that the new reality he brings requires new containers.

sections.section_title: The Son of Man and the Sabbath
sections.summary: Jesus defends his disciples' Sabbath grain-picking by appealing to David's precedent and declares the Son of Man Lord of the Sabbath, claiming authority over a divine institution.
